description: This file contains configuration and utility functions for Axios HTTP client setup in a React project, including base URL resolution, URL sanitation, token handling, and interceptors for request and response handling.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL string to prevent double-slash issues.

methods.name: ensureApiSuffix
methods.description: Ensures the base URL ends with '/api' or '/api/v1', appending '/api' if necessary.

methods.name: isKaviaPreviewHost
methods.description: Determines if the code is running inside a Kavia preview environment based on hostname.

methods.name: looksLikeKaviaProxyUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL resembles a Kavia proxy URL containing '/proxy/'.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves and returns the API base URL based on environment variables, current environment, and special handling for preview environment.

methods.name: stripApiSuffix
methods.description: Removes '/api' or '/api/v1' suffix from a URL if present.
